Name: (BFAV) Poultry Baba Yaga's House
Author: 3frogs
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296]Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety (BFAV)[/url]﻿ is required for this mod!

This mod adds a miniature Baba Yaga house to Stardew Valley as livestock you can adopt for your farm! The sprites are based on the house you can see inside the maze during the Spirit's Eve event. 
The Houses do not currently drop any produce, but I plan on adding eggs in a future update.

To add this creature to your game you will have to copy and paste this text to the config.json in the Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety folder:

"Baba Yaga's House": {
      "Types": [
        "Baba Yaga's House"
      ],
      "Buildings": [
        "Deluxe Coop"
      ],
      "AnimalShop": {
        "Name": "Baba Yaga's House",
        "Description": "A miniature version of Baba Yaga's house. Will it lay eggs?",
        "Price": "20000",
        "Icon": "assets\\animal_shop_baba yagas house.png"
      }
    },

You also must copy animal_shop_baba yagas house.png into Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety (BFAV)'s asset folder.
